messages:
jess: console graphs are blank for multiple customers — the panel just shows a spinning frame and then 'Failed to load data (500)'. Happening across multiple dashboards in the console. screenshot: https://redwood-inference.s3/incident/1751239876/graph-blank.png

ops-bot: Alert: analytics-api returned 500 for route /v1/metrics/query (count=42, window=5m)

samir: thanks — is there a repro? can you share the query and any request IDs you see in the browser/network tab?

jess: repro steps: 1) Open Console -> Project Alpha -> Dashboards -> Revenue KPIs 2) Click date range "Last 7 days" 3) Panels try to load, then show error. Network tab shows POST https://analytics.redwood/api/query → 500, response body: 

```
{"error":"internal_server_error","request_id":"abc123-req-775"}
```

I can consistently reproduce from my org account.

maya: I pulled analytics-proxy logs for the time range jess mentioned. There's a spike of 504/500 when the background ETL job hit a slow query. excerpt: 

```
[2026-02-12T15:02:44Z] ERROR proxy handler: downstream request failed status=504 path=/v1/metrics/query trace=abc123-req-775 latency=3.2s
[2026-02-12T15:03:01Z] ERROR analytics-service: panic retrieving aggregation: timeout after 2s; trace=abc123-req-775
```

Also seeing a deploy around that window: deploy-bot: "deploy finished" for tag analytics-service@v2.8.1 at 2026-02-12T15:00Z — not sure if related.

support-bot: Customer Impact: dashboards not rendering for multiple orgs. Priority: P1 if >10 orgs affected.

samir: ok. immediate ask: can you (jess) try setting the panel to a shorter time range (Last 1 hour) and re-run? want to see if query complexity/time window triggers it. also paste the full request payload if possible.

jess: tried 1h range — some panels now load, but the big aggregation panels still 500. full payload (redacted): 

```
POST /api/query
{
  "range": {"start":"2026-02-12T14:00:00Z","end":"2026-02-12T15:00:00Z"},
  "metrics": ["sum(token_cost)", "p95(latency)"],
  "group_by": ["model_version", "region"]
}
```

Response headers include: `X-Request-Id: abc123-req-775`, `Retry-After: 30`

maya: that payload matches the ETL-heavy aggregation path. On the service side a recent change to the query planner increased parallel subqueries; if workers are overloaded the DB times out and the service returns 500.

samir: next steps: 1) revert the query planner flag on analytics-service on prod (hotfix) 2) temporarily enable fallback to metrics-read replica that has more capacity 3) open an incident ticket and assign to eng-sre. Who can take on the hotfix?

miguel: i can take the revert and rollout a patch now. I'll patch flag `ENABLE_PARALLEL_SUBQUERIES=false` and roll 3 pods at a time. Will monitor error rate.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1423 -> assigned to eng-sre (miguel). Related customers: org-542, org-701, org-113.

miguel: hotfix rolled at 15:25Z. errors dropped to baseline within ~6 minutes. dashboards started rendering. leaving rollout at 3/3 pods. follow-up: perf ticket to revisit query planner change (ticket PERF-922).

jess: confirmed panels back for Project Alpha, Org-542. thanks miguel and team :thumbsup:

samir: closing loop: root cause = query planner change increased load + concurrent ETL causing DB timeouts → service returned 500s → console panels failed. Action items: (1) postmortem in #postmortems, (2) throttling/timeout protection in analytics-service to return a graceful 429 or cached result instead of 500, (3) add synthetic dashboard checks to detect these failures earlier.

maya: i'll start the postmortem draft and link logs + deploy timeline.

jess: adding customer notes and reply template for support reps. will mark resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
